entities.summary: Philippe Sarde (b. 1948-06-21, Neuilly-sur-Seine) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Neuilly-sur-Seine and France. Known in the fields of france, composers & musicians, europe.
